verdict.rationale: Muse is built around conversational control: users chat with the agent as they would message a person (mobile, Mac, or WhatsApp) and simply tell it what to get done. Tasks and goals can be managed by talking to it in chat, and side chats give separate context per topic. App-store reviewers and an HN commenter say people pick it up easily. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which product functions (settings, permissions, connectors) can be controlled via natural language versus UI only; independent hands-on testing of natural-language command reliability beyond anecdotal reviews.
